description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS A TEXT (spends credits): sends a 1:1 conversation text message immediately from one of your toll-free text numbers to a single contact. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/conversations. You need a textNumberId (from list_text_numbers). Returns the conversation.

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

textNumberId.description: The TextNumberID of the toll-free number to send from (see list_text_numbers). Required.

truncateIfExceedsLimit.description: Truncate the message if it exceeds the length limit (TruncateIfExceedsLimit).

name: send_text_message
title: Send a conversation text
